method: 3D SIMP topology optimization (parts/picogk-catalog/bionic/topopt.py) of the structure behind the exact functional surfaces, prepared by parts/picogk-catalog/bionic/prep_rotating.py; PicoGK smoothing, exact functional body fused
basis_note: Blades, vanes, wetted surfaces, rings and interfaces are the previous functional model, kept exactly (shaping.base_stl, regenerated by prep_rotating.py from out/<PART_ID>-functional.stl). Only the structural region described in optimization.design is re-grown (6.0 cm3 of the functional body removed there), for loads derived from the part's own engineering screen (synthetic operating points, not measured) and stated assumptions. A load-path concept, not a stress, burst or fatigue result.

design.note: per unit, the space between the turbine housing (volute, core, outlet; their gas paths excluded) and the wastegate actuator can, x 54..124 mm, |y| 318..382 mm, z 36..92 mm, with 7.5 mm clearance around the actuator rod and lever; the functional strut is not kept; written as 673 boxes (element-exact cover of it and the 1.5-element skin band next to it)

solid.note: fill of a sealed 47.7 mm3 pocket between the grown structure and the kept body, found by finish.py QA (powder trap); added after the optimization
fill of a sealed 86.5 mm3 pocket between the grown structure and the kept body, found by finish.py QA (powder trap); added after the optimization
